records.description: Sociolinguistic corpus of semi-directed oral interviews recorded across cities in Spain and Latin America. Contains 644 interviews of 20–45 minutes each, pairing WAV/MP3 audio with enriched orthographic transcriptions, some XML-annotated for pauses, overlaps, and noise. Coordinated by the PRESEEA project at the Universidad de Alcalá, with explicit LATAM coverage in Argentina, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, Uruguay, and Venezuela.

Spontaneous-speech corpus of informal, undirected conversations among speakers from Buenos Aires province, Argentina. The first version contains 24 oral recordings (participant mean age 29.74), pairing MP3 audio with orthographic transcriptions marked for orality cues — pauses, overlaps, and non-verbal semiotics. Recorded 2014–2019 and curated by the Grupo de Estudios Fonológicos at the Universidad Nacional de La Plata.

Crowd-sourced read-speech corpus of Argentinian Spanish from Google — short utterances paired with transcripts, originally released to enable LATAM-targeted TTS and ASR research. Splits cover 3,921 female and 1,818 male recordings, packaged by the HF mirror into parquet shards for streaming.

Mozilla Common Voice 26.0 read-speech corpus for Spanish — 1,680,810 crowd-sourced MP3 clips totaling 2,278.66 hours from 26,940 speakers, read from a 1,087,461-sentence corpus. Self-reported accents span Mexican, Andean, Rioplatense, Caribbean, Central American, Chilean, Canary, and peninsular variants — pan-LATAM coverage. Released CC0 with per-clip accent and variant columns enabling regional filtering.

Mozilla Common Voice 4.0 spontaneous-speech corpus for Spanish — 403 MP3 clips totaling 1.21 hours from 16 speakers, captured as free-form responses to prompts rather than scripted reading. Released CC0 to complement Common Voice's read-speech track with ASR training material that better reflects conversational delivery; only 37 clips are transcription-validated so far. Sub-variant coverage is not reported, so the language is tagged at the coarse es level.

VoxForge Spanish-language read-speech corpus — 23,537 utterances totaling 53 hours of audio from at least 483 volunteers, contributed since the project's launch to seed open-source ASR. Released GPL-3.0 as WAV with TSV transcripts; regional Spanish variants are present but not coded per-speaker, so the language is tagged at the coarse es level.

Leyes y decretos-ley de la Provincia de Buenos Aires from normas.gba.gob.ar (official provincial normative system). 106,628 article-level rows in parquet. Pipeline HTML-to-plain-text with conservation gates. Part of endomorphosis world-municipal-law project, AR-B jurisdiction.

Satellite-derived wildfire reconstruction for Formosa province (Chaco seco), September 2026. 11,786 fire detections from NASA FIRMS VIIRS, 53,873 ha fire footprint (82% native forest), 9,644 ha burned area measured by dNBR Sentinel-2/Landsat. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23602671.

Daily water levels for El Nino 2026 October flood event: 32 hydrometric scales across Parana (22), Iguazu (1), and Uruguay (9) rivers, 1 Sep to 23 Oct 2026. 1,728 rows. Source: Prefectura Naval Argentina via INA. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23600160.

Radar IA eCommerce Mexico 2026: which sites are cited by ChatGPT, AI Overviews, and Gemini for Mexican purchase queries. 19,950 queries per assistant (59,850 total), 13 categories, top sites by reach. First LATAM dataset measuring LLM citation in e-commerce. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23484475.

Names in Brazil 2022 (IBGE Census): 128K first names + 202K surnames, 6.4M rows in relational parquet. Frequency, ranking, distribution by sex, median age, decade, state, and municipality (5,570). Official source: IBGE public API censo2022.ibge.gov.br/nomes/.

Argentine imports 2017-2026 from ARCA (ex AFIP): 44M rows in parquet, two granularities (detailed items with NCM codes + historical aggregates). Documented pipeline, coverage Feb 2017 to Aug 2026. DuckDB-queryable via HuggingFace. Public foreign trade data.

Historical daily water levels for 22 Parana/Delta hydrometric scales from 1900 to 2026 (Rosario since 1900). 711,374 station-days, 32MB. Source: Prefectura Naval Argentina via INA. Includes 1983 flood per-scale comparison against official alert/evacuation levels.

Brazilian federal legislation in Markdown: Constitution, ordinary/complementary/delegated laws, decree-laws. 29,413 texts from Normas.leg.br (Senado Federal) + ctresb/leis, collected by OKF Index. Schema with ementa, URN, situacao, fonte. Snapshot 2026-10-20.

SNIIM (Sistema Nacional de Informacion e Integracion de Mercados, Secretaria de Economia MX) wholesale market prices: sample years 2000 and 2025 across all sectors (agricultural, livestock, fisheries, 47 endpoints). Prices in MXN. Full 1998-present is commercial; open NC sample.

Municipal regulations and ordinances from Mexico: pilot seed + tranches 1-2 covering 31 of 2,475 municipalities in 16 states, 48 documents. 11,503 rows with 19-column schema from the world-municipal-law program. Jurisdiction IDs are INEGI geostatistical codes. Coverage report included.

Peruvian municipal normative acts from gob.pe official section: batch 1 with 845 laws (Lima Metropolitan council agreements) + batch 2 with 3,873 laws (2,555 ordinances + 1,318 mayoral decrees, 9 Lima/Callao municipalities). OCR Tesseract spa 250dpi (27,189 pages, mean confidence 92%). Quality flags in metadata.

IR/GraphRAG release of ipfs_mexico_municipal_laws (pinned revision 8f814b1d): 12,419 canonical documents, BM25 index (91,717 terms, 1,203,988 postings), 384d gte-small vectors, graph with 46,960 nodes and 62,095 edges. 10 parquet configs with zstd compression.

IR/GraphRAG release of ipfs_peru_municipal_laws, same country-laws-ir-graphrag/v1 layout: corpus + BM25 index + vector embeddings + knowledge graph + adjacency matrix. 10 parquet configs with zstd compression.
